options.A: Recovery is the process of restoring or improving livelihoods, health, economic, physical, social, cultural and environmental assets and systems after a disaster; Build Back Better seeks safer and more resilient recovery rather than simply reproducing pre-disaster vulnerabilities
options.B: Recovery refers to actions during an event to save lives
options.C: Recovery refers to measures taken before a disaster
options.D: Recovery refers to immediate assistance to meet urgent needs

questions.explanation: Disaster recovery is the process of restoring or improving livelihoods, health, economic, physical, social, cultural and environmental assets and systems after a disaster. Build Back Better seeks safer and more resilient recovery rather than simply reproducing pre-disaster vulnerabilities.

questions.subject: Disaster Management
questions.question: Which of the following is a correct statement about disaster relief?

options.A: Relief is immediate assistance to meet urgent needs such as food, safe water, shelter, clothing, medical care, sanitation and protection; relief is one part of response and does not replace long-term recovery
options.B: Relief is the same as recovery
options.C: Relief is a preparedness measure
options.D: Relief replaces all other phases of disaster management

questions.explanation: Disaster relief is immediate assistance to meet urgent needs, such as food, safe water, shelter, clothing, medical care, sanitation and protection. Relief is one part of response and does not replace long-term recovery.

questions.subject: Disaster Management
questions.question: Which of the following is a correct statement about early warning systems?

options.A: Early warning systems are integrated systems that detect, forecast and communicate hazards and enable people and institutions to act in time; effective systems include risk knowledge, monitoring and forecasting, warning dissemination, and preparedness to respond; a forecast alone is not a complete early warning system
options.B: A forecast alone is a complete early warning system
options.C: Early warning systems do not require communication
options.D: Early warning systems do not require preparedness to respond

questions.explanation: Early warning systems are integrated systems that detect, forecast and communicate hazards and enable people and institutions to act in time. Effective systems include risk knowledge, monitoring and forecasting, warning dissemination, and preparedness to respond. A forecast alone is not a complete early warning system.

questions.subject: Disaster Management
questions.question: Which of the following is a correct statement about risk assessment?

options.A: Risk assessment is a systematic process of identifying hazards, analysing exposure and vulnerability, estimating likelihood and consequences, and evaluating risk to guide decisions; it may use historical data, hazard models, GIS, field surveys and scenario analysis
options.B: Risk assessment is the provision of relief after a disaster
options.C: Risk assessment is the reconstruction of infrastructure after a disaster
options.D: Risk assessment is the evacuation of people during a disaster

questions.explanation: Risk assessment is a systematic process of identifying hazards, analysing exposure and vulnerability, estimating likelihood and consequences, and evaluating risk to guide decisions. It may use historical data, hazard models, GIS, field surveys and scenario analysis.

questions.subject: Disaster Management
questions.question: Which of the following is a correct statement about vulnerability assessment?

options.A: Vulnerability assessment is the assessment of factors that make people or assets susceptible to harm, including building quality, poverty, age, disability, health, livelihood dependence, social exclusion, ecosystem degradation and limited access to information or services
options.B: Vulnerability assessment is the assessment of the size of an earthquake source
options.C: Vulnerability assessment is the assessment of rainfall intensity only
options.D: Vulnerability assessment is the assessment of relief requirements after a disaster

questions.explanation: Vulnerability assessment is the assessment of factors that make people or assets susceptible to harm, including building quality, poverty, age, disability, health, livelihood dependence, social exclusion, ecosystem degradation and limited access to information or services.

questions.subject: Disaster Management
questions.question: Which of the following is a correct statement about community participation in disaster management?

options.A: Community participation involves local residents, panchayats, urban local bodies, volunteers, civil-society groups and local institutions in risk mapping, planning, warning dissemination, drills, response and recovery; local knowledge improves relevance and trust
options.B: Community participation excludes local residents from disaster planning
options.C: Community participation relies only on national agencies
options.D: Community participation provides relief only after a disaster

questions.explanation: Community participation involves local residents, panchayats, urban local bodies, volunteers, civil-society groups and local institutions in risk mapping, planning, warning dissemination, drills, response and recovery. Local knowledge improves relevance and trust.

questions.subject: Disaster Management
questions.question: Which of the following is a correct statement about the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction?

options.A: It is a voluntary international framework adopted in 2015 for 2015–2030 with four priorities: understanding disaster risk; strengthening disaster risk governance; investing in disaster risk reduction for resilience; and enhancing disaster preparedness for effective response and to Build Back Better in recovery, rehabilitation and reconstruction
options.B: It is a binding international treaty adopted in 2005
options.C: It is an Indian law enacted in 2005
options.D: It is a state-level framework of Karnataka

questions.explanation: The Sendai Framework is a voluntary international framework adopted in 2015 for 2015–2030. It has four priorities: understanding disaster risk; strengthening disaster risk governance; investing in disaster risk reduction for resilience; and enhancing disaster preparedness for effective response and to Build Back Better in recovery, rehabilitation and reconstruction.

questions.subject: Disaster Management
questions.question: Which of the following is a correct statement about India's Disaster Management Act, 2005?

options.A: It provides the statutory framework for disaster management in India, including national, state and district authorities, plans, response forces and funds; it defines roles and coordination arrangements across levels of government
options.B: It provides only guidelines for earthquake-resistant construction
options.C: It provides only rules for flood relief
options.D: It provides only provisions for foreign aid

questions.explanation: The Disaster Management Act, 2005 provides the statutory framework for disaster management in India, including national, state and district authorities, plans, response forces and funds. It defines roles and coordination arrangements across levels of government.

questions.subject: Disaster Management
questions.question: Which of the following is a correct statement about the National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA)?

options.A: NDMA is the apex national body under the Disaster Management Act, chaired by the Prime Minister; it lays down policies, plans and guidelines for disaster management and supports coordination of national-level efforts
options.B: NDMA is a state-level authority chaired by the Chief Minister
options.C: NDMA is a district-level authority chaired by the Collector
options.D: NDMA is a specialist response force

questions.explanation: NDMA is the apex national body under the Disaster Management Act, chaired by the Prime Minister. It lays down policies, plans and guidelines for disaster management and supports coordination of national-level efforts.

questions.subject: Disaster Management
questions.question: Which of the following is a correct statement about the State Disaster Management Authority (SDMA)?

options.A: SDMA is the state-level authority under the Act, chaired by the Chief Minister, responsible for laying down state disaster-management policies and plans and coordinating state-level implementation
options.B: SDMA is the apex national body chaired by the Prime Minister
options.C: SDMA is a district-level authority chaired by the Collector
options.D: SDMA is a specialist national disaster response force

questions.explanation: SDMA is the state-level authority under the Act, chaired by the Chief Minister, responsible for laying down state disaster-management policies and plans and coordinating state-level implementation.
